summary: Failure to initialize the diagnostic log aborts startup before its error handler and can block shutdown.
evidence: With logs occupied by an ordinary file, rotating-log creation throws. app.whenReady calls libraryStage before its startup try, and beginShutdown emits action_started before its cleanup try. The backend also tried to create the same directory again.
proposed_fix: Log initialization failure once to stderr, keep a discard writer, and reuse the logger path in backend startup.
check: node --test tests/rotating-log.test.js from codebase/desktop (4 passed, including a real initialization failure).
